subject.title: fix(discord): preserve content-type and skip optimization for animated/WebP images

question: Should this fix expand public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/outbound-media` with `preserveWebp` and `preserveAvif`, or should media preservation stay inside the Discord/core media owner path until a generic SDK contract is approved?
rationale: The PR changes a public plugin SDK subpath for a Discord-specific behavior, and repository policy treats plugin API changes as compatibility-sensitive maintainer decisions.

options.title: Keep Preservation Internal
options.body: Rework the PR to avoid new public SDK options and implement the Discord fix through current Discord/media owner paths.

options.title: Approve SDK Expansion
options.body: Allow the new SDK options only with docs, API baseline/export checks, focused compatibility tests, and explicit maintainer acceptance of the contract.

options.title: Replace the stale branch
options.body: If the conflicts make repair too costly, keep the linked issue open and replace this PR with a fresh narrow fix that preserves contributor credit.

recommendation.title: Keep Preservation Internal
recommendation.body: Rework the PR to avoid new public SDK options and implement the Discord fix through current Discord/media owner paths.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across the Discord send path, shared outbound media plumbing, and plugin SDK public-contract surface involved in this choice.
